routes.name: 在留資格「日本人の配偶者等」

note: Japan, read in the laws as e-Gov's law API serves them (each as current on 2026-10-30): the Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act (Cabinet Order 319 of 1951), its Enforcement Regulation (Ministry of Justice Ordinance 54 of 1981, as in force 2026-10-01), its Enforcement Order (Cabinet Order 178 of 1998, as amended by Cabinet Order 268 of 2026, in force 2026-10-01) and the Nationality Act (Act 147 of 1950). A performer lives in Japan on the status of residence "Entertainer" (興行: theatre, performing arts, music, sport and other entertainment) or, as an artist earning a living from art, "Artist" (芸術); each allows only the activity of its status, which the game reads as work for the sponsor. Entertainer is granted for 3 years, 1 year, 6 months, 3 months or 30 days, Artist for 5 years, 3 years, 1 year or 3 months; the term kept is 1 year, with the fee for changing status or renewing for a 1-year grant, ¥33,000 on paper (¥27,000 online); a grant of 3 to under 5 years costs ¥64,000. Entry from abroad on a Certificate of Eligibility costs the Immigration Services Agency nothing; the visa's consular fee is not read. Permanent residence (永住許可) costs ¥200,000 and asks good conduct and the means of an independent living; the years the Agency's guidelines ask (10 in general) are not in the law and the Agency's pages (isa.go.jp) answered 403 to this client, so none is kept. Naturalisation asks five years' continuous domicile in Japan on any status, so each route's years count. A spouse of a Japanese national is granted 5 years, 3 years, 1 year or 6 months and may work at anything. Decision times are not in the laws.

sources.title: 出入国管理及び難民認定法 (e-Gov law API, current on 2026-10-30)
sources.said: 興行 演劇、演芸、演奏、スポーツ等の興行に係る活動又はその他の芸能活動（この表の経営・管理の項の下欄に掲げる活動を除く。） ... 在留資格を変更しようとする外国人で永住者の在留資格への変更を希望するものは、法務省令で定める手続により、法務大臣に対し永住許可を申請しなければならない。 ... 一 素行が善良であること。 二 独立の生計を営むに足りる資産又は技能を有すること。
